latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release – a detailed guide for sourcing beauty products from China.

- Provides up-to-date industry overview, supply chain structure, and regional manufacturing clusters.
- Covers all major beauty sectors: skincare, color cosmetics, hair care, body care, and fragrances.
- Offers sourcing recommendations with supplier evaluation tips and best practices.
- Aggregates insights from authoritative government and industry sources through Q1 2026.
- Features user-friendly, natural-language interactions for exploring China’s beauty market.
